div.head: Mirce 3
div.ab: Swa micel is þæs wergyldes on ……..
Swa micel is þæs wergildes on folces folcriht be Myrcna laga.
So great is [the size of] the wergild in the common law according to the law of Mercians;
So much is the wergild of the folk law of the people, according to the law of the Mercians.
Soviel ist [Betrag] dieses Wergeldes nach des Volkes gemeinem Recht im Mercier-Recht.
So much is [the amount of] this wergild by the people's common law under Mercian law.
div.note: The rest of the line (‘folces folcriht be Myrcna lage’, as in D and O) was already lacking in hlq, the exemplar of H. K: ‘is’ supplied from Liebermann. Liebermann compares Norðleod 1.
